member.name: M:UrlShortener.Api.Services.UrlShortenerService.AliasPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,32}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [-0-9A-Z_a-z] atomically at least 3 and at most 32 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
